WCI — what reps actually say, by question

Tap a topic → a question (times asked) → each response batch (similar answers grouped; count, % of answers, per-rep counts, on-script %) → every exact wording in that batch with how many times it was said and by which rep. “MOST COMMON” = the de facto script line. Pick a rep to see only their answers with their counts. Names/numbers show as [NAME]/[PHONE]/[DATE]; some ordinary words were masked by the de-identification layer.
